pictures.name: CA1-The-Wedding
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A village wedding feast in first-century Galilee at evening, in a courtyard strung with lamps and olive branches: a young bride in a saffron veil and a groom in a cream robe with a garland, guests in rich red, ochre and indigo robes laughing at long low tables of bread, figs and clay wine cups, musicians with a drum and a lyre. Among the guests, Mary, a woman about forty-five in a deep blue mantle over a cream veil with gentle dark eyes. A man in a plain cream cloak sits among his friends with his back to the viewer, face never shown. Joyful, warm, golden. The feast in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CA2-No-Wine
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. In a dim storeroom off the same wedding courtyard, two young servants in plain undyed tunics tilt a large clay wine jar to show it is empty, a last drop falling into a cup; a worried older servant woman presses a hand to her mouth. Through the archway behind them, the bright, oblivious wedding feast glows gold with lamps and dancing guests. Deep blue shadows in the storeroom. The empty jar in the middle. Quiet worry against celebration. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CA3-Mary-Notices
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. At the edge of the wedding feast, Mary (a woman about forty-five in a deep blue mantle over a cream veil, gentle dark eyes) leans close to speak to her son, who is seated in a plain cream cloak and seen only from behind, his face never visible. Her face is calm, kind and confident; with one hand she gestures toward two waiting servants in plain tunics standing nearby. Warm gold lamplight on Mary’s face, deep blue shadow behind. Mary in the middle. Tender, trusting. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CA4-The-Jars
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. In a lamplit stone courtyard, six tall carved stone water jars stand in a row. Servants in plain undyed tunics pour water from clay pitchers and leather buckets, filling the jars to the very brim, the water glinting. One young servant looks up, puzzled, toward a figure in a plain cream cloak standing at the far edge, seen only from behind. Deep blue night sky above, gold lamplight on the wet stone. The jars in the middle. Expectant, mysterious. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CA5-The-Best-Wine
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The head steward of the wedding, a portly older man with a short grey beard in a striped green and gold robe, tastes from a clay cup, eyes wide with surprised delight, the deep red wine glowing in the lamplight. Beside him a servant in a plain tunic holds a dipper above a stone jar now brimming with red wine, sharing a secret smile with another servant. Behind, the young groom in a cream robe turns toward the steward, puzzled and happy. Gold light, deep blue shadows. The steward and cup in the middle. Joyful surprise. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CA6-Today-Candles
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative oil painting in the same sacred style, lifelike faces, deep blue shadows, warm gold candlelight, of a modern scene today: in a side chapel of a Catholic church in the evening, rows of small votive candles flicker in red and gold glass in front of a gentle painted statue of Mary in a blue mantle with open hands. A young woman in a modern olive parka, with dark hair tied back, has just lit a new candle with a long taper and stands with her eyes closed, hands together. Soft gold glow, deep blue shadows. The candles and the woman in the middle. Hopeful, quiet. No text, no letters, no logos.
